cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CCA532, you are at Wuhan airport, Gate 211, information V received, request ATC clearance to Changsha.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是国航532，你在武汉机场，211号机位，收到通播V，请求ATC放行至长沙。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 532, Gate 211, information V, destination Changsha, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，国航532，211号机位，通播V，目的地长沙，请求ATC放行。

cards.audioText: CCA532, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Changsha via flight planned route, LKO-02 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 8400m, runway 04, contact Departure on 119.7, squawk 2016.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，武汉放行，可以按计划航路放行至长沙，LKO-02离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度8400米，跑道04，联系离场119.7，应答机2016。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Changsha via flight planned route, LKO-02 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 8400m, runway 04, Departure 119.7, squawk 2016, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往长沙，LKO-02离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度8400米，跑道04，联系离场119.7，应答机2016，国航532。

cards.audioText: [Now you are ready for pushback and start-up, contact Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经准备好推出开车，联系武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 532, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航532，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CCA532, Wuhan Ground, pushback and start-up approved, facing east.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，武汉地面，可以推出开车，头朝东。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved, facing east, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，头朝东，国航532。

cards.audioText: [You are now on the taxiway Z4 with your engines running. Ask Ground for taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在滑行道Z4上，发动机全部起动。向地面请求滑行指令。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA532, taxiway Z4 with engines running, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航532，滑行道Z4上，发动机全部起动，请求滑出。

cards.audioText: CCA532, taxi to holding point runway 04 via Z4, A. hold short of A4.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，沿滑行道Z4，A滑行至跑道04，在A4外等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via Z4, A. hold short of A4, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道Z4，A滑行至跑道04，在A4外等待，国航532。

cards.audioText: CCA532, Ground, caution, work in progress near the right side of taxiway A3.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，地面，小心，滑行道A3右侧附近正在施工。【复诵】
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到谨慎（滑行），谢谢，国航532。

cards.audioText: CCA532, Ground, give way to the A320 vacating on E3, when the traffic is clear, continue taxi A, A9, hold short of runway 04.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，地面，给滑行道E3上的A320让路，没影响后，继续沿滑行道A，A9滑行，在跑道04外等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Give way to the A320, when traffic is clear, continue taxi A, A9, hold short of runway 04, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给A320让路，活动清除时，继续沿滑行道A，A9滑行，在跑道04外等待，国航532。

cards.audioText: [Now you are airborne at 900m climbing, contact Wuhan Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机已离地，高度900米上升，联系武汉离场。】
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，国航532，离地，通过900米。

cards.audioText: CCA532, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000m on QNH 1020.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，武汉离场，雷达已识别，左转直飞DA，上升保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1020。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000m on QNH 1020, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，上升保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1020，国航532。

cards.audioText: CCA532, climb and maintain 6600m on standard, expedite passing 3900m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，上升保持标压6600米，快速通过3900米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 6600m on standard, expedite passing 3900m, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持标压6600米，快速通过3900米，国航532。

cards.audioText: [You are experiencing moderate icing while maintaining 6600m, request higher level and state Wuhan Control the reason.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在6600米遇到了中度积冰，请求更高飞行高度，并向武汉区调说明原因。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CCA532, maintaining 6600m, request higher level due moderate icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，国航532，保持6600米，由于中度积冰，请求高高度。

cards.audioText: CCA532, Wuhan Control climb and maintain 7200m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，武汉区调，上升保持7200米。【复诵】

cards.audioText: [Suddenly your starboard engine failed at 7200m, make an urgency call ATC, and request descent and return to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在7200米时，右侧发动机突然失效，紧急呼叫ATC，并请求下降，返回武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CCA532, maintaining 7200m, right engine failure, request descent and return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉区调，国航532，保持7200米，右侧发动机失效，请求下降，返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: CCA532, roger PANPAN, descend and maintain 4200m, turn left heading 010, expect radar vectors for runway 04.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，收到PANPAN，下降保持4200米，左转航向010，雷达引导至跑道04。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200m, left heading 010, expect radar vector runway 04, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持4200米，左转航向010，预计雷达引导至跑道04，国航532。

cards.audioText: CCA532, continue descend and maintain 3000m on QNH 1019.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，继续下降保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1019。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 3000m on QNH1019, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1019，国航532。

cards.audioText: [You failed to restart the right engine, ask ATC for priority landing, also ask for the longest runway for safety concerns.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【右侧发动机重启失败，向ATC请求优先着陆，提供最长的跑道。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CCA532, we failed to restart the right engine, request priority land and the longest runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，国航532，右侧发动机重启失败，请求优先着陆，并提供最长的跑道。

cards.audioText: [Now you have established on ILS approach runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经建立的盲降进近跑道36右，联系武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA532, established on ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，国航532，建立盲降进近跑道36右。
